title: Tree DFS: combining results
learn: return values up the tree, global answer vs return value (diameter pattern), passing state down
hook: Diameter of Binary Tree, Balanced Binary Tree and Lowest Common Ancestor all test one idea: the value a recursive call returns isn't always the answer. Separating "what my parent needs" from "the best seen so far" is the key to most tree mediums.

explain.prompt: Explain how to find the diameter of a binary tree in O(n): what the recursive function returns and how the answer is tracked.
keyPoints: every path has one highest node where it turns; its length there is left height + right height
the recursive function returns height (1 + max(left, right)) because a parent can only extend one side
a separate variable tracks the best left + right seen at any node
one postorder pass → O(n) time, O(h) space; computing heights separately per node would be O(n²)
